spans.s: यडन्त a secondary root formed by adding the affix यङ् in the sense of repetition and intensity, to roots having one syllable and beginning with a consonant: cf. धातोरेकाचो हृलद: क्रियासमभिहारे यङ्
यड्लुगन्त a secondary root formed by adding the affix यङ् to roots specified in
,23,24, which affix is sometimes dropped: cf. यङोचि च ;
. The yanluganta roots take the parasmaipada personal endings and not the atmanepada ones which are applied to yananta roots.
यड्लुगन्तशिरोमणि a grammar work dealing with the frequentative roots written by Pandita Sesakrsna.
